description: Replace your principal's principal_key and cut off every agent that should not keep access. Use it when the key may have leaked or when you want to revoke a group of agents at once. Returns the new key once. Needs your agent credentials and the current principal_key (argument or X-Principal-Key header). Returns the new key once; the old one stops working. Every agent registered under the previous key is revoked for good (AGENT_REVOKED) except you and the agents in keep_agent_ids (list_agents shows them); the result lists kept_agent_ids and revoked_agent_ids. A principal registered before keys existed has none: any of its agents can call this without principal_key to mint the first one, which revokes nobody.

agent_key.description: Secret returned by register_agent (or X-Agent-Key header)

keep_agent_ids.description: Other agents of the principal to keep working (you are always kept)

principal_id.description: The principal you act for (or X-Principal-Id header)

name: rotate_principal_key
title: Rotate the principal key
